name: desktop-web
description: Run a plain Acryl app (`export default app`) as a desktop app: an Electron window on the app's own server. `npm run desktop`; the app's code never imports electron. `acrylblends add desktop` picks this one for an app without the Blend plugins.
mount: nothing to mount: run `npm install`, then `npm run desktop` (the window opens on the app's own server; every electron call is in src/plugins/desktop-web)
